modules.name: game-engine
modules.description: 6-max poker game state machine: deck, dealing, blinds, betting rounds, pot calculation, hand evaluation, settlement

modules.name: bot-ai
modules.description: 5-style BOT AI decision system (TAG/LAG/TP/LP/GTO) with hand strength, position, and pot odds awareness

modules.name: gto-solver
modules.description: Simplified GTO strategy engine: preflop range tables + postflop heuristic EV + Monte Carlo, running in Web Worker

modules.name: game-ui
modules.description: Poker table visual components: SVG table/cards, action panel, raise slider, animations

modules.name: persistence
modules.description: IndexedDB data layer via Dexie.js for sessions and hand history storage

modules.name: hand-replay
modules.description: Post-game replay engine with timeline navigation and GTO decision analysis

modules.name: stats
modules.description: Statistics aggregation engine for overview, position/street breakdowns, and profit trends

modules.name: session-mgmt
modules.description: Session lifecycle management: create, pause, resume, end, seat assignment

modules.name: app-shell
modules.description: Top-level layout, routing, navigation, global UI state, error handling

implementation_tasks.name: Project scaffold: Vite + React + TS + Tailwind + Vitest setup
Dexie.js database schema, migrations, repository classes
Core game engine: deck, dealing, blind posting, hand state machine
Betting round logic: action validation and processing
Pot manager: main pot and side pot calculation
Hand evaluator: integrate pokersolver for hand ranking
Settlement engine: winners, pot distribution, chip movements
BOT style profiles: VPIP/PFR/AF/3Bet% for 5 styles
BOT decision engine: position-aware, style-weighted action selection
Preflop GTO range tables: import 6-max ranges as JSON
Postflop GTO heuristic: pot odds, hand strength, SPR-based EV
Monte Carlo simulation for equity estimation
Web Worker setup: GTO worker with timeout and degraded fallback
Service layer: API operations wiring engine + persistence
Session manager: lifecycle, seat assignment, BOT allocation
Zustand stores: game, session, and UI state
App shell, routing, TopNav with tab navigation
Card and table SVG components
Action panel: buttons, raise slider, confirm dialog
Game loop: user action → engine → BOT → UI update cycle
Animations: deal, flip, chip scroll, page transitions
Hand history list with infinite scroll and delete
Hand history detail view
Replay engine: timeline, step navigation, keyboard shortcuts
GTO decision analysis panel with quality color coding
Batch GTO evaluation for all decision points in a hand
Stats overview page with aggregation
Position and street stats with charts
Profit trend line chart with grouping toggle
Session status UI: status bar, new session dialog, summary modal
Error handling: IDB unavailable, Worker timeout, data corruption
Empty states, skeleton loading, GTO calculation indicators
Integration tests: engine, bot, GTO, service layer
E2E smoke tests: full hand lifecycle, session, replay, stats
